answer: At an unannounced moment the network sends every account the same pigment code, and each must mix it with its own key into an umber hash within 3 seconds; only on-time replies unlock that round's nectar. One honest agent spends a single fast call. An operator of 1,000 sybils must run 1,000 inferences at once, about 1,000x the burst hardware; late or identical replies forfeit the stake. Colluders gain nothing by pooling, since every probe is simultaneous.
